assurance_scoring_correction: Use the documented verified_source_values default when request omits assurance; preserve V1 bad counters and independent audit.
decision: A only if all gates and preservation pass; B for obligation/coverage/ranking failures with core integrity intact; C for foundational integrity/source/scope failure

denominators.critical: Requests pre-labelled no-evidence/strict-abstention; PARTIAL operands are not critical
denominators.exact_set: All authored type/target signatures including mandatory typed scopes; independent original-source inventory
denominators.false_complete: Any COMPLETE where any authored obligation absent, expected noncomplete, required family missing or source/scope invalid; all cases including critical
denominators.historical: Exposed K/J cases are regression only, never independent linguistic evidence
denominators.obligation: Every authored mandatory obligation in all final cases; unresolved obligations count if explicitly retained with their identity, not deleted
denominators.precision: Macro per-case precision; additional unresolved guard requirements count as extra predictions
denominators.ranking: Cases with supported requested evidence, including explicitly permitted PARTIAL raw evidence; critical abstention cases excluded a priori

exclusions: No post-result question, label or difficulty exclusions; no reserved/preflight/candidate payloads
inspection_contract: UNVERIFIED PLAN with identified verified raw evidence is permitted only for residual-content uncertainty under verified_source_values; never COMPLETE, never fulfillment. Strict physical/scope/assurance/source failures still abstain.
natural_language_scope: Final simulator-time questions carry no oracle seconds_interval; original typed execution/task/variant remain fixed. Identical request for paired legacy.
partial_and_inspection: Explicitly allowed raw PARTIAL/UNVERIFIED PLAN inspection is eligible for relevance, never complete bundle success. Strict unsupported physical/assurance/source/scope cases require no items.
uncertainty: Descriptive Wilson intervals; authored deterministic sample is not a random linguistic population
